standard_prerequisites.name: The formation of the derived pushforward of an S-perfect object commutes with arbitrary base change along cartesian squares
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the lemma to proving that Rf_*E is perfect.

standard_prerequisites.name: Noetherian approximation: schemes of finite presentation, their properness and flatness, and relatively perfect objects descend over filtered colimits of Noetherian rings after enlarging the index, by the Limits lemmas and the relatively perfect descent lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the Noetherian model X_i, E_i over R_i.

standard_prerequisites.name: Over a Noetherian base the derived pushforward of a relatively perfect object along a proper flat finitely presented morphism is perfect, by the perfect direct image lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the Noetherian case the approximation reduces to.

core_obligations: Cite the base change lemma so only perfection of Rf_*E remains, and set up the limit argument reducing to Noetherian affine bases (proof lines 9198-9202).

Descend: localize S affine, write R = colim R_i with R_i Noetherian, descend X to an X_i of finite presentation over R_i, then after increasing i assume X_i is proper and flat over R_i by the Limits lemmas, and descend E to an R_i-perfect E_i by the descend-relatively-perfect lemma (proof lines 9204-9213).
Apply the perfect direct image lemma to X_i -> Spec(R_i) with E_i, and transfer back along the base change using the already-proven base change property to conclude (proof lines 9214-9216).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to perfection of Rf_*E via the base change lemma (proof lines 9198-9202).
Descend the datum over the filtered colimit of Noetherian rings (proof lines 9204-9213).
Apply the Noetherian case and conclude by base change (proof lines 9214-9216).
